extracted.name: Watermelon Pie
extracted.description: This watermelon pie is made with watermelon jello, diced watermelon, and whipped topping for a simple, delicious, and refreshing summer dessert.
ingredient_lines: 1 (12 ounce) container frozen whipped topping, thawed
instruction_lines: Combine Jell-O and hot water in a large bowl; stir until dissolved and cool, 10 to 15 minutes.
Fold dessert topping and diced watermelon into gelatin mixture.
Pour mixture into the prepared crust. Cool in the refrigerator until set, about 3 to 4 hours.
